title: 撤离点
text:
能出去的地方。{c:warn}撤了这一局就结束{/c}：包里的东西带回{zone:仓库}，{zone:地上}的留在这儿，钱带出去。

费用：{extract_fee} 币（零即免费）。

texts.en:
A way out. {c:warn}Extract and this run ends{/c}: what's in your bag goes back to the {zone:仓库}, what's on the {zone:地上} stays here, and your coins come with you.

Fee: {extract_fee} coins (zero means free).
